name: launcher
description: Independent desktop launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition (provisional name).

scripts.rust:fmt: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/mod-meta/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.rust:lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/mod-meta/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path crates/mod-meta/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.check: npm run i18n:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:lint && npm run rust:test
